note: BAC only, as before: the other large issuers (Banco Industrial, Banrural, G&T Continental) weren't reached in this pass. BAC Guatemala's information on interest, late interest, fees and other charges on its credit cards (at 31 December 2025), read in full, prices its cards by brand and tier, not by name: Mastercard, Visa and American Express, each Clásica, Gold, Platinum and Black (the Business cards aren't written), in quetzales, at a nominal 24.00% (Mastercard) or 51.00% (Visa and American Express) to 64.80% a year, written at the top with the bottom as the range's lowest; a cash withdrawal fee of up to 5%, written at 5%; purchases in dollars carry up to 2% and in other currencies up to 3%, written as 3%; and a late charge of up to 300 quetzales, written at the top. The membership for access to benefits (up to 777 quetzales) is set by card and isn't written for the brand cards; the moratory rate is charged on top of the ordinary rate and isn't written as a penalty rate. The CashBack Restaurantes Visa Clásica's own page gives its membership: 247 quetzales a year from the second year (the first free is introductory), refunded on 9,000 quetzals of purchases in the year; it takes the Visa terms above. No minimum payment or grace period is stated.
